paper.title_en: Black hole quasinormal mode excitation and mixing for coupled fields
paper.abstract_en: The idea of testing the nature of black holes and possible deviations from general relativity from their oscillation spectrum, known as ``black hole spectroscopy'', has become an experimental science. In many modified theories of gravity, the gravitational perturbations couple to additional degrees of freedom, leading to mode mixing and to a more complex ringdown signal. We adopt the parametrized quasinormal mode formalism for nonrotating black holes to study coupled perturbations in modified gravity theories in order to understand how the interaction with additional fields affects the quasinormal mode frequencies and their amplitudes. We compute the quasinormal mode spectrum of the coupled system in the frequency domain using direct integration and a matrix-valued continued-fraction method. We then compare the results with time-domain evolutions, where we extract the mode frequencies and amplitudes using the Prony method as well as least-squares fitting. In the weak-coupling regime, the scaling of the amplitudes associated with the gravitational-led and secondary-led modes can be understood perturbatively. The excitation of additional families of ringdown modes can become significant even when the frequency shifts remain moderate. We use our numerical time evolutions to provide ready-to-use coefficients for the mode amplitudes for representative initial data configurations. We work out specific examples, including dynamical Chern-Simons gravity and the special near-resonant case of coupled perturbations between the polar and axial quasinormal modes. Our theory-agnostic characterization of coupled systems should be useful to quantify systematic effects in black hole spectroscopy with next-generation gravitational-wave detectors.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在参数化准简正模框架下系统研究修正引力中耦合扰动的频谱与振幅激发，结合频域积分、矩阵连分数法与时间域演化（Prony法及最小二乘拟合）交叉验证，并给出可供复用的模式振幅系数与动态Chern-Simons等具体算例，对下一代引力波探测的黑洞光谱学系统误差量化有直接参考价值；理论深度与方法严谨性信号较强，新近发表无引用属中性。
decision.title_zh: 耦合场的黑洞准简正模激发与混合
decision.abstract_zh: 通过黑洞的振荡谱来检验黑洞的本质以及可能的对广义相对论的偏离，这一被称为“黑洞光谱学”的想法已经成为一门实验科学。在许多修正引力理论中，引力扰动会与额外自由度耦合，从而导致模式混合并产生更复杂的铃宕信号。我们采用针对非旋转黑洞的参数化准简正模形式体系来研究修正引力理论中的耦合扰动，以理解与额外场的相互作用如何影响准简正模频率及其振幅。我们在频域中使用直接积分法和矩阵值连分数法计算耦合系统的准简正模谱。随后我们将结果与时间域演化进行比较，在时间域中我们使用Prony法以及最小二乘拟合来提取模式频率和振幅。在弱耦合区域，与引力主导模式和次级主导模式相关的振幅标度可以通过微扰方法理解。即使频率偏移保持适中，额外铃宕模式族的激发也可能变得显著。我们利用数值时间演化，为具有代表性的初始数据构型提供可直接使用的模式振幅系数。我们给出了具体示例，包括动力学Chern-Simons引力，以及极向与轴向准简正模之间耦合扰动的特殊近共振情形。我们对耦合系统的与理论无关的刻画，应当有助于量化下一代引力波探测器进行黑洞光谱学观测时的系统效应。
